kurz: Crème brûlée combines two principles: an egg custard that may only set gently, and a sugar layer that [[karamellisierung|caramelises]] in a flash.
bild_im_kopf: Soft and crunchy in one dish: pudding below, glass on top.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Stir cream, egg yolk and sugar together; do not whisk until foamy
schluesselmomente.warum: Air bubbles would stay visible in the custard.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Let it set in a water bath at a low oven temperature
schluesselmomente.warum: The water keeps the temperature gentle and even.
The custard firms up and the surface dries.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Sprinkle thinly with sugar and torch it
schluesselmomente.warum: The sugar caramelises in seconds while the custard underneath stays cold.
